At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
The Design Systems team creates the visual and interaction foundations that help Vanta deliver coherent, accessible, and high-quality experiences across the product. This team partners across the EPD organization to build the systems, patterns, and practices that enable product teams to move faster while maintaining a high bar for craft and usability.
As a Staff Visual Product Designer focused on Design Systems at Vanta, you will shape the visual language of our product and the systems that bring it to life.

You will define and evolve scalable patterns across our design and engineering ecosystems, partner closely with product designers and engineers, and help create a cohesive experience for customers navigating complex security and compliance workflows.

You’ll combine exceptional visual craft with systems thinking, product judgment, and the ability to influence across teams.
What you’ll do as a Staff Visual Product Designer, Design Systems at Vanta:
Define and evolve Vanta’s visual design language across product surfaces, creating a cohesive, distinctive, and scalable customer experience.
Set a high bar for visual craft across typography, color, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, and interaction details.
Partner with Design Systems, Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, and Brand teams to translate customer and business needs into effective system-level solutions.
Own and evolve foundational design system elements, including design tokens, component visual states, responsive behavior, theming, density, and platform-specific adaptations.
Create reusable patterns and guidance that help product teams solve common problems consistently while preserving flexibility for different customer workflows.
Design and prototype system components and end-to-end product experiences, using high-fidelity exploration to communicate intent and accelerate alignment.
Bring visual clarity and hierarchy to complex, data-rich workflows used by security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineers to ensure designs are implemented with fidelity, accessibility, performance, and maintainability in mind.
Establish principles, standards, and review practices that raise the quality and consistency of product design across Vanta.
Advocate for inclusive and accessible visual design, ensuring that color, contrast, typography, motion, and interaction states work for a broad range of users and contexts.
Help define how the design system supports emerging product needs, including AI-powered experiences, personalization, automation, and increasingly complex enterprise workflows.
Use customer insights, product data, usability feedback, and competitive research to identify opportunities to improve the system and its impact.
Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).
Facilitate critiques, workshops, and cross-functional reviews that help teams make stronger visual and product decisions.
Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, compelling narratives, prototypes, and a clear point of view.
Mentor product designers and contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, experimentation, and customer obsession.
Create documentation, examples, and enablement materials that make the design system easy to understand, adopt, and extend.
Define and measure the impact of the design system through adoption, consistency, accessibility, usability, delivery efficiency, and customer outcomes.
Represent Design Systems in planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums, helping teams align around a shared vision for the Vanta experience.
Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, strengthening design craft, and improving how Vanta approaches visual product quality.

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
8+ years of experience designing digital products, with significant experience in visual product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
Deep expertise in visual design for digital products, including typography, color, composition, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, interaction states, and data visualization.
A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft, thoughtful systems thinking, and the ability to improve product experiences at both the component and end-to-end workflow level.
Experience creating, evolving, and scaling product design systems used by multiple teams across a growing organization.
Strong understanding of design tokens, component architecture, responsive design, accessibility, and the relationship between design tools and front-end implementation.
A track record of turning ambiguous product and customer problems into clear, elegant, and reusable visual solutions.
Experience partnering closely with engineers to bring detailed visual designs to life and to make pragmatic decisions when implementation constraints arise.
Strong product thinking, with the ability to understand customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, and the broader relationships among product surfaces and workflows.
Excellent communication, storytelling, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying on formal authority.
Experience balancing consistency and flexibility, knowing when to use an existing pattern, when to extend it, and when to introduce something new.
A demonstrated ability to give and receive thoughtful feedback, mentor others, and raise the quality bar across a design organization.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.
Experience designing products in cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.
Experience with tools such as Figma and familiarity with front-end technologies or design system implementation workflows is a plus.
A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.
Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.
Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how you operate and deliver results.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

About Coursera + Udemy
Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Shape what comes next
By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

The Design & Research teams play a crucial role in Coursera's success by gathering learner and educator insights and translating them into recommendations that help Coursera achieve a seamless experience across its platform. As a Staff Product Designer, you will lead the design strategy and execution for a major product area.

You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science across multiple teams to shape scalable experiences that drive meaningful outcomes for millions of learners and customers.
This role requires creating clarity from ambiguity, influencing product direction, and transforming complex challenges into simple, elegant, and inclusive solutions. As Coursera and Udemy come together to redefine how the world learns, this work sits at the center of our platform strategy. We're also looking for designers who embrace AI as part of their design practice—using it to accelerate exploration, synthesize insights, prototype ideas, and improve the quality and speed of design decisions.

Lead the design vision, strategy, and execution for a major product area — shaping its strategic direction while ensuring design quality and craft excellence across every stage of the product lifecycle.
Define and navigate ambiguous, complex problem spaces while leveraging insight across customer, business, and operational areas to frame initiatives and drive a strategic point of view.
Partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and data scientists to design and ship experiences that scale across the catalog.
Design new functionality within existing systems, and drive the definition of new patterns and formats as the space evolves.
Partner with research and data leads to synthesize quantitative and qualitative insights into cohesive, actionable design recommendations that shape product direction.
Apply AI fluently as part of the craft itself — using AI tools to accelerate discovery, ideation, prototyping, and iteration — while exercising sound judgment about where AI assistance helps versus where it shortcuts thinking that shouldn't be a shortcut.
Communicate design rationale effectively to influence cross-functional and senior stakeholders, and mentor designers across pods to raise the bar for craft and storytelling.

10+ years of experience as a UX or Product Designer, with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex solutions across one or multiple product areas.
Experience with core UX methods — including facilitating workshops, conducting user research, synthesizing insights, creating user flows, defining information architecture, and producing wireframes and prototypes — with a track record guiding teams from discovery through delivery.
Experience with interaction and visual design, including leveraging and contributing to design systems.
Demonstrated ability to design responsive, mobile-first experiences informed by user research and data insights.Proficiency in design and collaboration tools such as Figma and FigJam.
Working fluency with AI tools in the design process (e.g., using AI for research synthesis, concept generation, rapid prototyping, or content drafting), with the judgment to know when not to use them.
Demonstrated history of communicating design rationale to influence cross-functional partners, and mentoring other designers to raise the bar for design quality.

Experience designing AI-driven or agentic products, including prompt-based interactions and best practices for human-AI collaboration.
Experience designing for consumer SaaS, enterprise, or EdTech platforms.
Track record of using AI tools to change how you work (not just what you ship) — e.g., building lightweight prototypes or internal tools with AI assistance to test ideas faster.
Passion for education, learning transformation, and Coursera's mission to make world-class learning accessible to everyone.

BeInCrypto is a part of the media group BeInNews Ltd, a global newsroom and research team covering institutional finance and digital assets as they intersect: regulation, trading infrastructure, and market structure - backed by original data and a team reporting from every major time zone.

Our 100+ journalists and analysts operate across 50+ countries, publishing in 26 languages. We are official media partners at Money20/20, Digital Assets Forum London, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049, Proof of Talk, and other leading industry events.

We’re searching for a Senior Graphic Designer to redefine how the world’s leading crypto media brand looks and feels as we evolve into an institutional-grade financial intelligence platform. This is a role for someone who loves creating visually striking concepts as much as crafting polished digital experiences.

Around 60% of your time will be dedicated to graphic and visual design (editorial covers, campaigns, presentations, branding, and key visuals), while 40% will focus on web and UI design, shaping landing pages, website sections, and digital interfaces.

You’ll have the freedom to bring bold ideas to life, influence our visual direction, and build work seen by millions of users and the industry’s biggest players.
Tasks
Lead the evolution of BeInCrypto’s visual identity across digital products, editorial, marketing, and sales materials.
Create concept-driven editorial covers, social media covers, one-pagers, banners, reports, infographics, presentations, and key creative assets that communicate complex ideas through compelling visual storytelling.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
As a Senior Product Designer at DeepL, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the translation experience at the heart of DeepL Translate, the AI-first translation platform millions of people reach for every day to localize their content. You'll join a cross-functional team that is central to delivering a fast, trustworthy, and scalable product, collaborating closely with product managers and engineering leaders to define and drive the product vision.
Beyond your immediate team, you will actively contribute to DeepL's broader design community—helping evolve our craft, influence best practices, and raise the bar for design across the company.
This is a high-impact role for a designer who is comfortable navigating complexity, cares deeply about user experience, and thrives in collaborative, strategic environments.

You will be responsible for solving a critical problem: making translation feel effortless and trustworthy for anyone who needs to communicate across languages — whether they're translating a sentence, a document, or their daily work. We expect you to:
Become an expert on who our users are and what each user group needs, from casual translators to professionals who rely on DeepL every day
Conduct generative and evaluative user research to define problems and validate solutions
Gather and evaluate requirements with cross-functional team members
Communicate design concepts early and often, backed by qualitative insights and quantitative data
Deliver vibe coded prototypes, final design specifications in Figma and make small code changes in production
Share the responsibility to maintain and expand the design system

You have 4+ years of experience in product teams providing design solutions for web applications
You have a strong understanding of user-centered design processes
You have experience designing for B2B audiences but have a great eye for design. Experience in B2C design is a bonus point
You can drive design throughout the whole lifecycle of an idea — discovering problems, defining success, evaluating solutions, and measuring impact
You understand the power of storytelling and are comfortable in driving stakeholders buy-in

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! You'll partner directly with engineering to land the migration, then build the AI-forward design practice on top of it: the patterns, tooling, and workflows for designing agentic product experiences. This is a senior IC role reporting to the VP of Design, operating with wide autonomy in a deliberately flat, senior team.

Own the design system end to end: design tokens, component libraries, documentation, and the code components engineers consume, across two converging product surfaces.
Lead the migration of our component architecture to a modern stack (shadcn/ui, Storybook), partnering with engineering to re-baseline scope and ship a complete, production-quality tranche.
Define the governance that outlives any individual: versioning, contribution model, release process, and explicit exit criteria for design handoff that both design and engineering sign.
Establish Anaconda 's AI-forward design practice: patterns, guidelines, and tooling for agentic product surfaces, and ship the first product experiences that use them.
Work in design and code: prototype in the production stack and review component implementations.

Instagram is seeking a Product Designer to help lead our Shop Everything effort.

Shop Everything is our bet that any piece of content on Instagram can become a storefront — that when you spot a jacket in a creator's morning routine, a lamp in a travel Reel, or a skincare product in a friend's Story, you should be able to tap and buy it, or discover five others like it, without ever leaving the app.

We're building a world where shopping is as native to the experience as liking or commenting: seamless, trustworthy, and rewarding for the creators who make it possible.

As a key member of our design team, you will be responsible for ensuring that our products and features are valuable, easy to use, and of the highest level of craft and execution.In this role, you will design both sides of that exchange.

On the creator side, you will empower creators to monetize their content and grow their businesses — defining how they add products to their content, how those products show up to their audience across Feed, Reels, Stories, and Profile, and how AI-assisted flows like automatic product tagging and search across millions of catalogs make earning from their content feel effortless rather than transactional.

On the consumer side, you will turn inspiration into action across the end-to-end purchase experience, from the moment of interest through consideration, cart, and checkout.

That means rebuilding the product detail page around AI-assisted decision-making rather than static product information, designing a cart that persists across Instagram so people can gather things over time and return when they're ready, defining how much of a purchase someone can delegate to an AI agent and how they stay in control of it, and earning trust across a marketplace of third-party sellers with uneven product data and different ways of checking out.

The ambition on both sides is to be differentiated and forward-looking: defining new patterns and experiences rather than replicating existing ones.

Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, and 2023, 2026 and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact.

We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger.
Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.
High Standards. No Apologies.
We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. This isn’t a 9-to-5.

Our team is deeply committed, often putting in 60+ hours a week –not because we’re told to, but because we’re invested. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home.

If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it.

We’re looking for a product designer who thinks beyond aesthetics. Someone who is as passionate about crafting seamless user experiences as they are about beautiful interfaces. You care deeply about building, shipping, and iterating on real products, not just making polished mockups that never see the light of day.
As a Product Designer on our mobile team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the Eight Sleep app, driving the design of engaging, intuitive, and seamless experiences that help users optimize their sleep and health. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, and Research & Development teams to craft high-quality, data-driven designs that balance aesthetics with usability.
We don’t believe in rigid design silos. At many companies, product design is split into UX, UI, and other sub-disciplines. Here, it’s all in one. You should be an exceptional generalist who can move fluidly between information architecture, visual design, and interaction patterns, with an eye for both pixel perfection and real-world usability.

As a key member of our small but growing design team, you'll have significant ownership over the app experience, ensuring that users can effortlessly track, understand, and optimize their sleep performance while maintaining long-term engagement with the Eight Sleep ecosystem.
How you’ll contribute
We are a mission-driven company, so passion for what we do and our mission is key. At a high level, the role encompasses three areas:
Design: You’ll sit at the intersection of Design and Product, playing a key role in the end-to-end design and evolution of the Eight Sleep app. Your responsibilities will encompass the full spectrum of product design, from information architecture and low-fidelity wireframes to high-fidelity mockups, and everything in-between.
Validate: You’ll conduct usability studies and user interviews to inform design work, and work closely with our in-house customer discovery squad. You’ll use data to inform the success or failure of the design.
Iterate: You’ll combine qualitative and quantitative customer insights to make design decisions that improve our app experience, reduce churn, and increase engagement.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Prompts spec out what Claude does. Evals measure whether it did. The Product Prompt and Eval Design team does both for product design: the system prompt that greets a new user, the tool descriptions that decide whether Claude searches, the instructions that keep a slide deck from tipping into slop, and the evals that test all of it.

The point is to keep the model and the product aligned with what users expect, what the product strategy calls for, and what safety requires, on every surface and through every model launch.
This role is a foundational member of that work on the eval side: building the evals that check the prompts, the harness that runs them, and the tools that let designers do this work themselves. It sits on the Product Prompt and Eval Design team in Product Design, works day to day with the team's surface owners and the engineers in each product team, and pairs per surface with the prompt engineering team at model releases.

Write and revise the prompts behind Claude's tools, features, and behaviors on a product surface; test the surface, turn findings into prompt fixes, ship them, and confirm the prompt users get is the one intended
Build the graders that prove a prompt fix and rerun on the next model; turn designers' hand-run rubrics into automated evals, then read transcripts for what the eval missed
Build visual, low-code eval tools designers can use without an engineer: assemble a comparison set from real transcripts, turn a plain-English rubric into a grader, compare prompt variants across models side by side, and read results in the tool rather than a notebook
Watch designers use those tools and make them simpler
Support model releases: test each surface against the new model, write prompt fixes and migrations, and write prompts for features launching with it, so the surface owner's call has numbers behind it
Stand up and scale the eval harness: build the test environment that exercises our 50 to 100 tools with trustworthy settings, keep evals green across models, and call whether a regression is the harness or the model
Package what prompting can't fix for training, with the eval attached: graders for crisp behaviors, human-feedback questions and good/bad pairs for fuzzy ones like writing quality

Production-quality Python
Experience building and maintaining evaluation pipelines for LLM products: graders, rubrics, comparison sets, regression suites, and the plumbing that runs them across models
Experience building internal tools with a real interface for people who do not write code
Experience standing up test harnesses, sandboxing tool calls, and pinning the settings that make runs comparable
Experience shipping prompts, or working closely with people who do, and understanding why a prompt that works on one model fails on the next
Reads transcripts, not only scores

Has worked inside a model-launch cycle
A/B testing experience and the ability to connect offline evals to online outcomes
Front-end or notebook-to-app experience, and opinions about what makes an eval result legible at a glance
Has turned product rubrics into training signal: graders, human-feedback questions, or preference pairs
Cares how Claude behaves for the people using it, not only whether the metric moved

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

About Design at Gusto
Design at Gusto is made up of over 80 creative, collaborative people who care deeply about our mission to empower small businesses and their employees. We're a cross-functional group that is always looking for opportunities to build understanding and empathy for the people who use Gusto.

We don't care much about swim lanes and though we care deeply about quality and craft, we are never precious about it. We work closely with cross-functional partners in Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to design, build, and ship experiences that make a real difference.
We are building an AI-native design organization — and we mean that seriously. We're looking for designers who are already working this way: using AI to prototype ideas quickly, shorten customer feedback loops, and ship quality UX directly to customers.

Gusto's Growth team owns the full customer funnel — from a small business's first visit to gusto.com through onboarding and into ongoing expansion. Two of the most complex, cross-cutting systems inside that funnel are how we price and package our products, and how we orchestrate the messages customers get across email, sales, and in-product surfaces. Neither has ever had dedicated, systems-level design support until now.
This role is leveled at the equivalent to a Staff-level. As Product Designer in this scope, you'll own the design system for how promotions, tiers, and SKUs are presented consistently across the funnel, including a unified checkout experience, and drive the next wave of iteration following our fall pricing & packaging refresh.

Alongside that, you'll partner closely with our Revenue Systems team to define the target-state UX vision for customer-centric orchestration: establishing how a customer experiences one coordinated set of communications across email, sales, and in-product/AI surfaces, rather than a patchwork of independent touchpoints, and drawing the line between what belongs at the platform level versus the channel level.

You'll round this out with lighter-touch, ongoing design support for Invoicing & Billing as needs arise, including near-term work like multi-entity billing.
This is a systems-thinking role, with direct impact on revenue generation. You'll need to be as comfortable zooming out to define a multi-team experience architecture as you are zooming in to get the details of a specific surface right, and you'll need a strong customer experience and business sensibility to match.

Gusto's Growth team is dedicated to helping customers discover, adopt, and expand into the Gusto ecosystem in meaningful ways.

You'll be joining a collaborative, cross-functional team of designers, engineers, PMs, data scientists, and key business partners who care deeply about customer experience — and who operate at the intersection of product-led growth, marketing, and sales.

In this role, you'll work closely with partners across Growth & Commerce, Revenue Systems, Sales, Marketing, and BizTech, while serving as the lead designer across several interrelated surfaces and systems.

Design dynamic pricing and packaging displays that span the funnel—from acquisition through activation and billing to ensure that buyers will quickly and confidently purchase Gusto products.
Design across Gusto's invoicing and billing surfaces, building on the recently rebuilt IBEX platform
Build and improve internal tools such as the Promo Engine and Product Catalog, and improve existing workflows in Gusto's internal platforms, to enable self-service and better outcomes for internal teams across Growth, Marketing, Accounting, Sales, and Expansion Sales.

Use a mix of data and qualitative insights to validate decisions, inform tradeoffs, and refine designs over time through iteration.

Your mission We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.
You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.
English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.
Concretely, you will: Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
Run the experiment, and read it honestly . Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Polish goes where it changes behaviour, not onto every surface.
Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.
Your profile You practice design, and you are very comfortable with numbers. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
You have technical know-how. You need to be able to construct the pipelines and dashboards yourself, use our experimentation platform, and our design system tooling.
You get your own numbers. Whether through SQL, AI-assisted querying, or both, you do not wait for someone else to pull data for you.
You have run experiments end to end. Hypothesis, design, instrumentation, analysis, decision. Not just handing a mockup to someone who tested it later.
You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
You use AI as a tool already or want to. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack.
You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.
Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.
Team
The Design team at Raisin brings together product designers and brand & marketing designers; we are united by our shared belief in the power of respect, creativity, and the purpose to give people financial peace of mind.
We’ve built a place where empathy and innovation thrive, where integrity and high quality standards underpin our work. We love our diversity and use the strength of our perspectives to reach our goals.
Product Design Principles
We are supportive
Build confidence by removing the unnecessary and focusing on what matters. Reveal information, features, and controls progressively to create a secure, transparent, accurate, relevant, and consistent experience.
We create delight
Make every design engaging and enjoyable. Use strong visuals, clear data, and thoughtful copy. Treat design quality as essential. Add moments of surprise and joy whenever possible.
We act universal
Design smart experiences that adapt to user behavior, use context, and anticipate intent. Keep interfaces familiar, welcoming, and clear yet advanced. Make every interaction simple and intuitive.
We are authentic
Bring your whole self and ensure diversity of perspectives. Speak plainly, disagree respectfully, support each other, commit fully, and celebrate progress together.

Create desirable, usable digital products and features
Own design activities to launch and improve features that help customers register, authenticate, manage their accounts, and make payments. Look for places where AI can make complex interactions simpler.
Own design activities to improve internal customer-service and operations tools to help serve our customer base.
Lead rapid prototyping activities. Use generative and agentic tools to turn bold concepts into something people can try and share feedback on.
Support larger end-to-end design discovery and delivery, guided by more senior design peers.
Hold the bar on quality and ethical guardrails
Make quality a habit: validate quickly, and iterate. Use qualitative research, operational metrics, and security and compliance feedback to keep UX guardrails clear and real.
Run feedback loops so AI-generated work meets a high ethical and quality standard.
Collaborate across functions
Work with product managers, engineers, and data specialists to design and ship high-quality experiences. Be proactive in the way you work together.
Partner with peers, engineers, and data specialists to experiment and to put in place the UX infrastructure for AI-driven features. Co-create products that are personal and highly secure.
Tell a clear story. Explain your design intent, choices, and trade-offs to team and stakeholders. Ask for feedback, and give it clearly and openly.
Turn technical and compliance requirements into usable experiences
Translate complex backend and platform capabilities, including AI/ML models and agentic logic, into interfaces that customers and internal teams can easily use.
Surface compliance requirements, for customers and for internal customer-service teams, and use them to shape experiences that are robust and friendly at the same time.
Contribute to a living design system
Adopt reusable, flexible UX patterns, and add new ones when needed, so we make micro-frontends look - and feel - cohesive.
Work closely with the team responsible for the Raisin Design System, so components and patterns stay accessible, consistent and well documented across platforms.
Help the live design system grow: contribute spec-to-code delivery of components and scalable UX patterns when they support the features, services, and experiences you are designing.
Stay curious, and keep experimenting
Keep your craft fresh. Stay current on AI capabilities and on how design work changes when agents are in the loop, so Raisin’s design practice stays sharp.
Your Profile
3+ years in product design, ideally in fintech, platform services, or another highly regulated, complex environment (for example healthtech, legaltech, or high-stakes SaaS) where trust, long-term decisions, and compliance really matter.
A portfolio that shows strong product design experience in complex products and systems: user-centered methods, and real examples of AI/ML-driven features, agentic workflows, or conversational interfaces.
A clear understanding of how to design for AI: system uncertainty, predictability, user trust, error prevention, and " human-in-the-loop " feedback mechanisms.
Practice with user-driven validation techniques: qualitative, quantitative, and analytics-based.
A good grasp of how to design with generative and agentic tools, both to explore concepts faster and to build high-fidelity work, for delivery.
Ability to take active part in cross-functional workshops, including with engineering-heavy partners such as data scientists and AI/ML engineers: ask the deep questions, translate design language into ways other functions will grasp, seek active co-creation and elicit feedback.
A data-informed mindset. Comfortable working with security, compliance, operational KPIs, and AI system metrics (model accuracy, latency, user feedback loops).
Strong storytelling that keeps stakeholders and peers with you - as you walk them through your design decisions - including the ability to explain complex AI logic or automated systems in simple, human terms.
A proactive learner. You already use AI-augmented workflows (research synthesis, copywriting, ideation, delivery) to work faster without lowering the quality bar.

Acquiring Dashboard experiences, including payment pages and analytics, ship with clear flows, strong usability, and a consistently high level of interaction and visual craft.

Core product designers go deep on durable product experiences; you help the business development team make a future capability tangible, then feed what you learn back into product.

s.h: What this looks like in practice

Turn an emerging customer need into a convincing prototype in days, even when the original brief is incomplete or contradictory

The second is Piper's live presence, the chat and video experience where the AI is the rep. The work is in the details: the micro-interactions, latency handling, turn-taking, and tone that make it feel credible instead of uncanny.
The design patterns for autonomous agents in enterprise sales are still being figured out. You'll be part of that.

s.h: Here’s what you’ll do as a Senior Product Designer
s.t:
Lead significant product initiatives from problem framing and discovery through design, validation, delivery and post-launch iteration
Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to define the right problems, shape product direction and balance customer value, business goals and technical feasibility
Turn complex financial journeys and requirements into clear, accessible and trustworthy experiences across web and mobile
Use qualitative research, behavioural data, experimentation and product metrics to identify opportunities, evaluate trade-offs and measure the impact of your work
Plan and conduct appropriate research and validation, including user interviews, usability testing, concept testing and collaborative workshops
Develop and communicate a coherent design vision for your initiatives, connecting long-term direction with practical, iterative steps
Create high-quality user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, interfaces and specifications, including edge cases and non-ideal states
Collaborate with Engineering early and throughout delivery, considering feasibility and ensuring the implemented experience meets the intended quality
Contribute to and evolve our design system, creating reusable patterns and improving consistency between design and production
Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully throughout the design process; for example, to support research synthesis, problem framing, exploration, content design, rapid prototyping, data analysis and design reviews
Evaluate AI-generated work critically, protecting customer privacy and applying human judgement to accuracy, accessibility, quality and appropriateness
Communicate recommendations and design decisions clearly, using evidence and storytelling to build alignment and influence stakeholders
Mentor and support other designers through critique, feedback and practical guidance, helping raise the team’s overall quality and confidence
Improve the way we work by identifying opportunities to make design processes faster, clearer and more effective
You’ll report to our Head of Product Design.

We don’t expect you to meet every single requirement listed. What matters most is your motivation, mindset and ability to learn. If you’re excited about this role and think you could be a great fit, we’d really like to hear from you.
5+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products within cross-functional product teams
A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership, strategic product thinking, polished UX/UI craft and measurable customer or business impact
A track record of independently leading complex initiatives from an ambiguous starting point through discovery, delivery and iteration
Strong product judgement and the ability to balance desirability, usability, viability, feasibility and delivery constraints
Advanced interaction and visual design skills, with close attention to detail, accessibility, consistency and usability
Strong systems thinking, including an understanding of how design decisions affect connected journeys, platforms, teams and future product development
Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and component-based workflows, with experience contributing to or evolving design systems
Confidence choosing and applying appropriate research and validation methods rather than relying on a single process for every problem
Experience using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions and evaluate outcomes
Practical familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows or clear evidence of actively developing this capability across areas such as ideation, research synthesis, content, prototyping, analytics or design review

Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
Für Design ist das ein seltener Ausgangspunkt: Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Für diese Berufe hat noch nie jemand ernsthaft gestaltet. Du wärst die erste Design-Person in unserem neuen Produktteam und baust Design-System und Designprozess mit auf.
Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Wir arbeiten als ein Team von Product Engineers , manche technischer, manche gestalterischer. Du wärst die gestalterischste Person, arbeitest aber im selben Repository und Rhythmus wie alle anderen. Was du gestaltest, ist meist wenige Wochen später live.
Du verantwortest den Designprozess von Anfang bis Ende : Du führst Interviews mit Verwaltern und Eigentümern, verdichtest die Erkenntnisse zu Konzepten und gestaltest daraus Interfaces für Kundenportal und Verwaltercockpit. Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg.
Deine Designs bleiben nicht in Figma : Mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) bringst du sie selbst ins Frontend und setzt Teil-Features, teils auch ganze Features, gemeinsam mit dem Team um. Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Produkt landet, und legst dafür selbst Hand an.
Ein besonderes Feld ist Design für KI-Agenten : Du gestaltest Interaktionsmuster für Workflows, in denen Agenten Aufgaben übernehmen. Wo braucht der Nutzer Kontrolle, wo Transparenz? Muster, für die es noch kaum Vorbilder gibt.
Was du mitbringen solltest 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign, gern mit B2B-Software oder komplexen Workflows.
Ein Portfolio mit 2 bis 3 Case Studies, die deinen Weg von der Nutzerfrage bis zum ausgelieferten Interface zeigen: Deine Denkweise interessiert uns mehr als die Menge an Screens.
Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, von Wireframes über klickbare Prototypen bis zur Komponentenbibliothek.
Erfahrung mit qualitativem Research: Interviews führen, Erkenntnisse verdichten, Annahmen mit Usability-Tests prüfen.
Gespür für Interaction Design und Informationsarchitektur in datenreichen Anwendungen.
Gute bis sehr gute Praxis mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, v0): Du bringst Teil-Features oder ganze Features selbst in den Code.
Solide Grundlagen in HTML und CSS, JavaScript ist ein Plus.
Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.
Was wir dir bieten Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
Echter Impact. Alles, was du gestaltest, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.
Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, Richtung UX Engineering oder Produktverantwortung, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich.
Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen.
Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es.
Perspektive. Diese Stelle ist so gebaut, dass sie mit dir und mit lpeOS wächst.

Our work sits at the intersection of product thinking, brand expression, behavioral insight, and interaction design. We’re constantly exploring new ways to make growth experiences feel more useful, intuitive, expressive, and distinctly Instacart.
We pride ourselves on a culture of experimentation, accountability, and craft, continuously evolving how we design for conversion, engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer II to join the Lifecycle & Growth team and help shape some of Instacart’s most important customer experiences.
This role is ideal for a highly conceptual, craft-driven designer who is energized by ambiguous problems, 0→1 exploration, and bringing new ideas to life through exceptional visual, interaction, and motion design.
You’ll work across high-impact Growth initiatives spanning partnerships, incentives, and lifecycle experiences. The work may include exploring new partner-led entry points, rethinking how incentives are surfaced and understood, or creating new lifecycle experiences that improve conversion, reactivation, and retention.
You’ll work at the intersection of product, brand, content, interaction design, and growth strategy, deeply understanding both the customer experience and the business mechanics behind it to create new ways for people to discover, engage with, and return to Instacart.
Many of these opportunities won’t start with a defined solution. You’ll be expected to explore broadly, challenge existing patterns, and translate customer needs, business goals, and emerging capabilities into compelling product experiences.
You’ll move fluidly between big-picture concepts and the smallest interaction details, developing new product ideas, prototyping behaviors, refining motion and micro-interactions, and carrying strong concepts through to polished execution.

Lead high-impact Growth initiatives across partnerships, incentives, and lifecycle experiences, taking work from ambiguous problem framing through exploration, refinement, and launch
Reimagine key moments across the customer journey, including how people discover Instacart, understand value, convert, reactivate, and build ongoing habits
Blend product thinking, brand, content, interaction design, and business mechanics to create unified experiences rather than solving individual surfaces in isolation
Explore and prototype new content models, flows, interaction patterns, motion, and messaging that challenge existing conventions and unlock stronger customer and business outcomes
Design complex, multi-step journeys that span surfaces and teams, identifying opportunities to create greater continuity, clarity, and cohesion across the experience
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content Design, Research, Brand, and Data Science to synthesize diverse inputs into clear creative direction and actionable product decisions
Use customer insight, experimentation, and business metrics to evaluate tradeoffs, shape recommendations, and iterate toward measurable impact
Define scalable patterns and interaction models that extend beyond a single feature, improving quality and coherence across the broader Growth experience
Use prototypes, AI-enabled tools, and emerging workflows to make ideas tangible early, accelerate learning, and improve how teams explore and build
Raise the craft bar through exceptional visual and interaction design, strong storytelling, and clear rationale that helps teams align around a shared direction

7+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products across web and mobile
A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual, interaction, and product craft, including strong 0→1 work
Deep interaction design skills, with experience in motion, micro-interactions, prototyping, and product behavior
Strong conceptual thinking, with the ability to turn ambiguous opportunities into clear, compelling product experiences
Proven ability to design complex journeys while balancing customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, and craft
Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale and influence cross-functional partners
Comfortable operating autonomously, exploring broadly, and carrying work from early concept through polished execution
Curiosity and fluency with AI-enabled tools and workflows, using them to accelerate exploration, prototyping, and product development
Experience in growth, subscriptions, marketplace, commerce, or other high-scale consumer products

Team & Role
This role is part of our Product Design team that uses their superpower of empathizing, understanding, and applying our users’ and customers’ needs, with the mission to created product experiences they love. Our designers come from a varied set of skills and background - design systems, visual, interaction, content, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has a very intentional seat at the table, so our team collaborates closely with both engineering and product management from the get-go.

Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.
That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. As our new Senior Product Designer , you'll lead and execute product initiatives from concept to UI, bringing a user-focused mentality to everything you ship.

You'll join a small, close-knit Product Design team, report to the Head of Product, partner day to day with Research, Product Management, and Development, and work with other teams as collaborators and stakeholders.

It's a hands-on senior design role with the opportunity to grow into leading the PD team as it scales, while staying close to the design work
Your primary canvas is MyKinsta, the dashboard where our customers manage their sites, but your scope also extends to the service layer to cover the full user experience of Kinsta. This means a design output can include internal workflows, customer communication, or additional tooling.
You'll work with a high level of autonomy while you design features, manage stakeholders, provide UX guidance, and occasionally step in to own a project through delivery. The ideal Kinsta Senior Product Designer is a strong craftsperson, a confident decision-maker, curious, collaborative, and self-motivated.

Own design projects end to end (concept, scoping, user flows, UI, release, and follow-up), at any scale, from small improvements to strategic new capabilities.
Drive discovery: define what to build to address real problems and user needs, and study competitors and best practices.
Work closely with Research, Product Management, and Development: request and apply insights, align on business requirements, and validate technical feasibility.
Write clear specifications so design intent is unambiguous, and run design QA against both the intent and the Kinsta Design System.
Give clear rationale for your decisions, resolve design and product deadlocks, escalate when you need feedback or mediation, and communicate trade-offs when priorities compete.
Serve as Project Owner on occasion. We don't have full-time delivery managers, so one team member leads each project as its Owner during delivery, communicating progress and coordinating releases.
Be a product expert: know how our product works, the personas and use cases we support, and how that translates into UI-level design solutions.
Represent the craft: uphold professional standards in design thinking, problem solving, usability, UX, and UI; give and receive design critique; and help maintain and evolve the Kinsta Design System.

Experience working in a SaaS environment, on a highly technical product, in cross-functional teams.
Hands-on experience across the full design workflow: research, problem definition, ideation and facilitation, creating UI, and partnering in delivery.
Expert-level proficiency with Figma.
Experience working with and maintaining a design system.
A portfolio with at least one case study taking a project from a problem statement to a delivered solution. We want to see your process and how you arrived at decisions, not only screens and a general workflow description.
A good understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JS). You don't need to write production code, but you should have a working sense of feasibility and be comfortable poking at things in an Inspector.
Proactivity: you take the initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.
Professional-level English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience working on a hosting or web infrastructure product.
Experience with technical products where the audience is developers or technology-oriented users.
Experience with the WordPress ecosystem.
Experience mentoring or leading other designers.

Storyous je pokladní systém pro gastro podniky, který funguje samostatně v rámci fintech skupiny Teya , k níž jsme se připojili v roce 2021.
Naše portfolio stojí na robustním pokladním systému, pokročilé datové analytice a dalších modulech, které ve spojení s integracemi a vlastním platebním řešením Teya tvoří komplexní all-in-one řešení pro jednotlivé podniky i řetězce s desítkami poboček.
Hledáme Product Designera/ku , který/á bude designovým partnerem pro Product a Engineering a převezme odpovědnost za UX/UI napříč celým produktem. Budeš převádět produktová zadání a vlastní nápady do promyšlených návrhů a prototypů, hledat příležitosti ke zjednodušení uživatelských cest a podílet se na tom, jak bude Storyous fungovat v praxi.
Jedná se o nově vytvořenou roli s velkou mírou autonomie. Máme existující design language a designové podklady ve Figmě , ale současně plánujeme větší redesign tabletové aplikace a chceme náš design dále sjednocovat a rozvíjet.
Co tě v roli čeká
Budeš navrhovat UX/UI napříč tabletovou aplikací, webovým Adminem, mobilní aplikací, Kioskem a Premium Analytics.
Zapojíš se do přípravy a realizace většího redesignu tabletové aplikace.
Budeš převádět produktová zadání, zákaznické potřeby a vlastní návrhy do user flow, wireframů, interaktivních prototypů a finálních návrhů ve Figmě.
Budeš aktivně hledat místa, kde lze produkt nebo uživatelskou cestu zjednodušit a zlepšit.
Vyrazíš do terénu za našimi zákazníky, povedeš user interviews, budeš pozorovat používání produktu v reálném provozu a využiješ zjištění pro další návrhy.
Budeš rozvíjet naše design language, komponenty a šablony a dbát na konzistenci napříč platformami.
Budeš úzce spolupracovat s Productem a Engineeringem od prvního nápadu až po implementaci.
Budeš řešit designová dilemata, připravovat návrhy včetně potřebných stavů a edge cases a dokumentovat designová rozhodnutí ve Figmě, Jira a Confluence.
Budeš využívat AI nástroje, například Claude, pro zrychlení rutinní práce, iteraci návrhů a tvorbu klikacích prototypů.
Koho hledáme
Tahle role je vhodná pro člověka, který už má zkušenost s designem digitálních produktů a chce převzít širší ownership. Nehledáme pouze někoho, kdo umí vytvořit kvalitní obrazovku. Potřebujeme designera, který rozumí problému, umí pracovat s uživatelem, dokáže návrh obhájit a dotáhnout ho ve spolupráci s týmem.

s.h: Hodit se k nám budeš, pokud
Benefit Plus Cafeteria s měsíčním kreditem 2 000 Kč;
s.t:
flexibilitu a možnost občasné práce z domova;
MacBook a další vybavení potřebné k práci;
palivo v podobě čerstvého ovoce, snacků a kvalitní kávy v naší karlínské kanceláři;
nově vytvořenou roli s velkým prostorem pro vlastní iniciativu a rozhodování;
přímý vliv na UX/UI celého produktu a možnost vidět dopad své práce u reálných zákazníků;
plnohodnotný onboarding do produktu a podporu při poznávání domény.
Proč může tahle role dávat smysl právě tobě
Nechceš být pouze vykonavatelem hotových designových zadání, ale chceš ovlivňovat, co a proč se bude v produktu stavět.
Baví tě kombinace samostatné práce, user research, prototypování a spolupráce s engineeringem.
Chceš pracovat na produktu, který lidé používají v reálném a náročném provozu.
Hledáš prostředí, kde můžeš využít dosavadní zkušenosti a zároveň si vybudovat silný ownership nad celou produktovou oblastí.
Vyhovuje ti autonomie, ale zároveň víš, že s ní jde ruku v ruce odpovědnost za kvalitu výsledku.
Jak probíhá výběrové řízení
Pošli nám CV společně s portfoliem. Zajímá nás, na čem jsi pracoval/a.
Proběhne krátký call s HR (online).
Následovat bude interview se Zuzkou, naší Product Managerkou, kde si řeknete více o roli, produktu a způsobu spolupráce (osobně u nás v kanceláři).
Dáme ti krátké praktické case study zadání s rozumným časem na přípravu.
Ve finálním kole case study společně projdete se Zuzkou a designovým expertem z Teya (online).
Zní to jako role pro tebe? Pošli nám CV a portfolio. Rádi se s tebou spojíme, představíme ti detail role i fungování týmu a pobavíme se o tom, jak by mohla vypadat naše spolupráce.

s.h: Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
s.t:
At Teladoc Health , you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Teladoc Health is a highly-collaborative, fast-paced, innovative environment where you’ll find your excitement building as you’re both challenged and gratified by progress, every day. As a Senior Product Designer on the Consumer Experience team, you'll work with high-impact teams focused on improving the experience of delivering healthcare for consumers.

Set a high standard for craft: You’ve earned confidence because of the consistent quality of your work, and you have a history of setting the standard for what strong design looks like.
See design as a team sport: You know a cohesive, rational end-user experience depends on connected work, and your approach is collaborative because of it. You design with that in mind from the start.
Lead with intellectual humility: You ask when you're unsure, own it when you're wrong, and actively seek out perspectives that challenge your thinking.
Hold strong opinions, lightly: Your work is considered and opinionated at every turn, and you have the confidence to approach it as such. But you recognize digging in doesn't help move anything forward and have the judgment to know when to advocate and when to adapt.
Earn trust through positive collaboration: You present your work in a way that makes it possible for others to engage, and you facilitate conversations that move things forward rather than stall them out. You expect different perspectives and navigate disagreements without frustration, caving, or bulldozing.
Turn complexity into simplicity: Healthcare has no shortage of ways to make something more complex; you resist that urge at every turn.

Lead complex design work for consumer experiences across web and mobile, from early-stage problem framing through shipping, translating ambiguous problem spaces into clear, well-reasoned design directions
Partner closely with other members of the UX team and cross-functional partners to deliver cohesive, efficient, and compassionate digital experiences
Use early design concepts to shape requirements, not just respond to them
Champion a user-centered approach that reflects real healthcare consumer needs, balancing user needs with business goals and technical feasibility without losing sight of any of them
Present to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders with clarity and confidence
Ground decisions in data, user research, and usability testing; willing to jump in and do research when appropriate
Engage with the design system as a thoughtful contributor, raising issues and pushing for improvements when the work calls for it
Identify and push back on product or technical constraints that compromise the user experience, offering alternatives rather than just objections
Elevate those around you through specific, honest, and actionable feedback

As a Senior Product Designer for Kiosk, you will end-to-end own and elevate the guest-facing ordering experience across thousands of global restaurant locations. By combining exceptional interaction craft with strong product sense, you will define the product roadmap, design intuitive interfaces, and directly drive key guest funnel outcomes like completion rates, average ticket size, and ordering speed.
This is a contract, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Paris office and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

Set the multi-quarter design vision and end-to-end guest experience (approx. 30%): Own every guest-facing touchpoint—attract screen, menu browsing, item customization, upsell, checkout, payment hand-off, confirmation, and edge states—ensuring consumer-grade polish under fixed hardware and fluorescent lighting conditions .
Define and own the Kiosk guest product roadmap (approx. 25%): Drive measurable guest-funnel metrics (order completion rate, time-to-order, attach rate, average ticket size, abandonment points) by synthesizing behavioral data, restaurant visits, support insights, and competitive teardowns into prioritized product briefs and sequencing decisions .
Prototype, validate, and deliver design-to-code specs (approx. 15%): Build high-fidelity interactive and code-based prototypes to validate flows with real guests before development, delivering detailed specs (tokens, states, motion, accessibility) and conducting design QA on staging builds to enforce the design-code contract .
Architect and govern the Kiosk white-label design system (approx. 15%): Design and evolve a multi-tenant system that maintains visual integrity across hundreds of distinct restaurant brand identities, varied hardware types, poor assets, and internationalization standards (European Accessibility Act / WCAG 2.2 and multi-language/RTL layouts) .
Leverage AI workflows and drive cross-functional leadership (approx. 15%): Supercharge research, spec writing, and ideation using AI tools to accelerate delivery from discovery to ship in weeks; bring engineers, PMs, and commercial leads across global regions to clear decisions; and mentor peer designers through pairing and critique .

5+ years of experience in product design with an outstanding portfolio demonstrating visual craft, interaction design, and product thinking (experience in Kiosk, POS, in-store ordering, checkout, or payments is strongly preferred) .
Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or equivalent practical work experience .
Demonstrated product sense with experience writing briefs, establishing roadmap priorities, running experiments, and driving funnel metrics when operating with or without a dedicated PM .
Hands-on experience architecting and scaling complex white-label or multi-brand design systems, including working knowledge of EAA/WCAG accessibility and multi-language/RTL support .
Code-aware background with a strong understanding of frontend capabilities, technical logic, and performance constraints to effectively partner with engineers on technical implementation .
AI-native mindset, leveraging AI tools as a daily productivity lever for research, ideation, spec creation, and high-fidelity prototyping .
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with proven ability to present ideas, negotiate scope trade-offs, align global cross-functional stakeholders, and mentor team members .

Own the Prediction Markets experience from early thinking through launch and iteration.
Define how users discover markets, understand them, trade and manage their positions.

Work closely with Product and Engineering to shape what we build, not just how it looks.

Squarespace's Commercial Growth organization brings together the product, engineering, and strategy teams responsible for how Squarespace builds, prices, and grows its business across every product line. We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to own the end-to-end commercial experience across cart, checkout, cross-sell, and pricing pages.

This is the right role for a senior designer who understands that commercial UX is not just a conversion problem — it's a systems problem. Own the Commercial Product Design Surface: Lead design across plan selection, cart merchandising, and cross-sell — creating cohesive, intentional experiences across the full commercial ecosystem rather than isolated flows.

Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. As a Principal Product Designer at Flex, you’ll solve problems for consumers across the country who are underserved by existing financial products. Product Designer
In the 1960s, the Italian artist and inventor Bruno Munari was studying spontaneous forms: shapes that emerge from the interaction of material, function, and environment.
When Danese Milano commissioned him to design a lamp that was practical, durable, affordable, and easy to transport, Munari was reminded of the traditional rice paper lanterns he had encountered when traveling in Japan. But rice paper lanterns are fragile, hard to clean, and tend to yellow over time.
Looking for an industrial alternative, he discovered filanca—a synthetic stretch nylon used exclusively for women's stockings at the time.
Munari visited hosiery factories to test the material and see what forms it could take. "We do not make lamps, sir. Only stockings," one factory told him. Munari replied, "You'll see."
The result was the Falkland lamp: only a few centimeters thick when packaged, as tall as a human when hung, its spontaneous form emerging from the elasticity of the nylon and metal rings of different diameters inserted at regular intervals, enlarged by gravity when suspended from above.
Munari didn't begin with the form of a lamp. He began with the qualities it needed, then looked outside the conventions of lighting to find the right materials and methods. We're looking for a designer who works the same way: someone who studies the systems and materials at hand, then finds a way of putting them together that feels both unexpected and inevitable.
At Co–Star, the materials are a 4,000-year-old system of astrology, planetary data from NASA, and a corpus written by astrologers and poets. The qualities we're designing for: astrology made accessible without asking anyone to learn a complex system, and a language that lets people share something intimate with their friends.
We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to continue cultivating those qualities across Co–Star and new experiments. You'll move between product architecture, interaction design, prototyping, and visual design. Ideas rarely arrive as polished specs. You'll help decide what we make next and how it works.

You care about the details—typography, layout, motion, responsiveness, loading states, and performance—that make an experience great.
